decisions.reason: The LED supply and level-shifting decision does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing architecture or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change USB standalone-power activation, LDO capacity, or the currently specified loads on the standalone 3.3V rail.
The existing boost requirement already includes addressable LEDs only when configured for 5V; the conditional preference for a 3.3V LED does not alter the boost rail or its control.
The source changes the electrical supply and logic handling of the main-board LED, not its charge-status role, GPIO, or CHGLED connector circuit.
The LED voltage and level-shifter decision does not change any interboard connector, signal assignment, power signal, or pin-order requirement.
The source does not affect the battery connector, battery voltage range, pin functions, or AXP2101 connection.
The source concerns the main-board status LED power logic and does not identify or change the separate 16-LED board array.
The source does not change the power-board USB-C connector, its data lines, or its sourceability constraints.
The LED supply and data-level decision does not alter I2C clocking, pull-ups, cable length, or series resistors.
The source does not affect the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or net labeling.
The electrical choice for the main-board LED does not necessarily change the power-board dimensions, connector arrangement, mounting, or enclosure fit.
The source does not modify battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal, or other protection behavior.
